name: Argonne National Laboratory — campus, Advanced Photon Source and Physics Building
notes: Argonne has no accelerator, beamline or detector record in the atlas, so every feature here is a context shape (entity_id null) except the campus boundary and the derived APS orbit, which are attached to site:argonne-campus.

anl.gov, aps.anl.gov, www.phy.anl.gov, map.anl.gov and the sandbox mirror all returned HTTP 403 to every fetch attempt (checked 2026-10-25); the statements used come from the APS operations pages (ops.aps.anl.gov) and OSTI-hosted laboratory documents.
The APS storage-ring orbit is drawn as a derived circle (see geometry:argonne-aps-storage-ring-orbit); the ATLAS layout is not located.

summary.plain: Argonne National Laboratory's campus near Lemont, Illinois, drawn to scale: the ring-shaped Advanced Photon Source hall with the storage-ring path inside it, the injector buildings, and the Physics Building that houses the ATLAS heavy-ion linac.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:argonne-national-laboratory. Drawn from OpenStreetMap: the campus fence polygon (way 4372309), the APS Experiment Hall multipolygon (relation 3126234), the APS linac tunnel (411) and injection wing (412) buildings, and Building 203 (the ATLAS building). Derived: the APS storage-ring orbit as a circle of the published 1103.609 m circumference, concentric with the hall's circular outlines (accuracy 10 m). Not drawn: the internal layout of ATLAS.

unlocated.backlog: Obtain the ATLAS floor plan (phy.anl.gov/atlas/facility/floorplan.html, an unscaled graphic) or a surveyed drawing of Building 203 and georeference it against at least three building corners from the OSM footprint; official plans may only be cited, never copied.
unlocated.reason: ATLAS accelerator layout (injectors, booster linac, ATLAS linac, target areas I-IV). Only the Building 203 footprint is drawn; the laboratory's own layout figure is an unscaled cutaway, and no fetched source gives the beam axis or hall outlines inside the building. The official ATLAS floor-plan PDF and the 'Facility Layout with Beam Locations' page (anl.gov) and phy.anl.gov documents returned HTTP 403 again on 2026-10-25, and a floor plan of equipment would in any case need three identifiable building corners to be georeferenced. The Atlas has no accelerator record for ATLAS.
